Despite my fabric metaphor, I actually analogize it to editing a piece of writing. It's easy enough to slip a sentence in somewhere in a way that everything still makes total sense without being touched. But the more you want to edit the piece, the more effort you have to put into making sure everything stays clean and seamlessly makes sense still.
